target.graphic: Straight-set serif ALABAMA (charcoal-heather fill, crimson outline) + circular University of Alabama seal rising behind letters + charcoal ALUMNI ribbon banner below
target.color: MUST be a shade of gray. Ash / light heather ideal; charcoal viable. Hard pass on red/crimson, white, cream/ivory, oatmeal, sand/tan, black — color is gated before graphic.
target.blank: Jerzees Super Sweats (Russell Corp, Alexander City AL, WPL 7332), Made in USA, ~50/50 +5% other fiber
target.size: L or XL only. 42-44 (90s L) ideal; modern L-XL fine. XXL/2XL is a HARD NO as of 2026-09-03 (Drew's direction) - a 2XL wears too big, no exceptions however good the print.
target.priceGuide: 20-50 USD typical comp; up to ~75 for exact match
target.colorRule: Added 2026-08-30 at Drew's direction: a non-gray sweatshirt is not a viable option regardless of how exact the print is. Non-gray items may be logged as documentation comps but never surfaced as candidates.
target.sizeRule: Added 2026-09-03: only L and XL are entertained. XXL/2XL items may be logged as documentation of a print family but never surfaced as candidates or dossier cards.

channels.notes: Facebook Marketplace unblocked 2026-08-30 when Drew signed the Chrome profile into Facebook. FB relevance collapses under sortBy=creation_time_descend — use default (suggested) sort, and sweep local pickup separately from shipping. | 2026-08-31: FB image srcs are unreadable from JS (blocked) — screenshot the results grid instead. Etsy/eBay/Depop/Grailed/Poshmark grids are best eyeballed by injecting a labeled grid into a live marketplace tab (file:// previews render as static snapshots and never load images). | 2026-09-03: Mercari DID render in the in-app Claude Browser this run (item titles live in the card , not the anchor text) — the 'real Chrome only' note is no longer absolute. Facebook was the only blocked channel. Verify eBay liveness with the JSON-LD schema.org availability string, NOT innerText phrase matching — eBay's inline scripts contain both 'This listing has ended' and 'Buy It Now' on every page and produce false positives either way. | 2026-09-07: Mercari, Depop, Grailed, Poshmark and Etsy all rendered fine in the in-app Claude Browser; only Facebook was blocked (extension offline). Image-grid eyeballing must render at scrollY 0 in ONE viewport - the in-app pane does not paint below the fold and returns blank screenshots, and computer{action:'zoom'} region-cropping is not supported there, so magnify by rendering a single oversized inside an overflow:hidden div instead. Search-result thumbnails desaturate: etsy:4538672718 read gray in the grid and is maroon at full size. eBay liveness via a cross-origin fetch of the item page + regex on the JSON-LD availability string works and is cheap - seven ids in one call. | 2026-09-10: eBay, Etsy, Poshmark, Mercari, Depop, Grailed and the AlabamaVTG products.json sweep all rendered in the in-app Claude Browser; only Facebook was blocked. Two gotchas re-confirmed: (a) an injected extractor function does NOT survive navigation, so inline the whole extractor in every javascript_tool call rather than stashing it on window; (b) Etsy listing pages cannot be read by cross-origin fetch (returns an ~800-byte stub) - navigate to the listing to check liveness, while eBay JSON-LD availability via cross-origin fetch works fine and checked five ids in one call. eBay 318838769762 went OutOfStock three days after listing, so the correct blank at ~$18 sells inside a week: sweep newest-first more often than twice weekly. | 2026-09-14: FACEBOOK UNBLOCKED for the first time since Aug 30 - the claude-in-chrome extension reported one connected local browser and the Chrome profile was still signed in to Facebook, so shipping (radius=805) and local-pickup (radius=161) both swept clean. Two FB gotchas: (a) a /marketplace/search URL without an explicit radius silently collapses to the profile's home city within 60 mi and returns 'No listings found' even for queries that have hits - always pass radius; (b) the empty-state copy keeps saying 'within 60 miles' even after the radius filter visibly updates, so trust the filter rail, not the message. Also: an Etsy search URL with &order=date_desc can return a hard zero for a query that returns 64 results without it - drop the sort before concluding a term is dead. All ten channels rendered in the in-app Claude Browser except Facebook, which needs real Chrome. | 2026-09-17: eBay, Etsy, Poshmark, Mercari, Depop, Grailed, AlabamaVTG and Facebook (both shipping radius=805 and local pickup radius=161) all swept - zero blocked channels for the second run running. Three gotchas worth keeping: (a) a cross-origin fetch of an eBay item page only works from a tab whose origin IS ebay.com - the same call from a grailed.com tab throws on every id, so navigate to an eBay page before batch-checking liveness; (b) Depop search thumbnails come back as blurry lazy-load placeholders and the P0.jpg full-size variant 404s, so judge Depop off the card alt text (it states color and gender) or open the listing, never off the grid image; (c) the in-app pane needs ~3-4s after injecting an image grid before the screenshot has pixels in it - screenshotting immediately returns labels on white. | 2026-09-21: eBay/Etsy/Poshmark/Mercari/Depop/Grailed/AlabamaVTG all rendered in the in-app Claude Browser. Facebook is signed in and sweepable for SHIPPING, but the account's Marketplace location is set to Hamden CT - the /marketplace/birmingham/ slug resolves to Birmingham UK and /marketplace/tuscaloosa/ silently falls back to Hamden, so the Alabama LOCAL-PICKUP sweep is not reachable by URL. Changing it means editing the account's location setting, which this run did not do. FB search-grid JS extraction returns {} (blocked) - use find{query} to get a ref and click through for ids, and read tiles off a full-resolution screenshot, not a 0.6 scale one. eBay liveness via cross-origin fetch only works from an ebay.com origin tab; curl is blocked outright.
